_comment: #438 [Wild Sage] -- the EVOLVED-TAMER consolidation, end to end, automatic (#472). Sibling of druid_consolidation_loop.json; this one owns the thing that loop cannot show -- that an EVOLVED [Beast Master] consolidates into its OWN class instead of merging back into [Druid] at the cost of its whole bond kit. Fixture near_wild_sage_consolidation: beast_master 11 + mage 10, the cheapest legal pair under min_parent_level 10 + min_combined_level 21, merging to max(ceil(2*21/3), max(11,10)) == 14. THE ROW THIS SCRIPT REALLY GATES is the ORDER of classes.json's `consolidations[]`: `WIProgression.check_consolidation` returns the FIRST match and [Druid]'s `[beast_tamer]` line's evolution closure still reaches beast_master, so if the wild_sage row ever sinks below druid's this script reds on `target: wild_sage` rather than silently handing a bonded rider [Druid] in a build nobody replays. THE OPAQUE-UNTIL-SLEEP LOCK is proved before the bed rather than asserted in prose: on a freshly loaded save standing at the threshold, no consolidation event has been emitted and both parents are still held. The closing fight is the kit proof, and it is the whole argument for this class existing: [Sworn Fang: Ride Together] is [Beast Master]'s OWN L14 grant arriving through `inherits` -- the Skill a merge into [Druid] would have silently deleted -- alongside [Counsel of the Wild], the consolidation's own new grant, and [Flash Step] from the mage half, so both parent lines are shown surviving the merge.

steps._comment: The EVOLVED pair, held. [Beast Tamer] is gone -- Replacement took it at 10, which is exactly the orphaning this family was authored to close.

THE OPAQUE-UNTIL-SLEEP LOCK, proved rather than asserted in prose. This save stands ON the threshold: both parents clear min_parent_level and their sum is exactly min_combined_level. If eligibility resolved anywhere before the sleep beat, the merge event would already be in this run's stream -- and it is not.
The fixture stands at your_bed facing it, so the beat is one interact away; the inn walk is consolidation_flow's subject, not this script's.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: THE ROW #438 EXISTS FOR. beast_master + mage resolves to wild_sage, never druid -- and to the SAME derived floor, since the merge formula never looked at which lineage the parents were.
#472: consolidation is AUTOMATIC. There is no prompt to answer, so the absence of an offer event is part of the contract rather than an accident of this fixture.

lines:1 = the single merge-announce line. This fixture sits exactly at the threshold and banks no class or level announcements, so a second line here would mean progress text leaked into the veil -- the opaque-until-sleep product lock, read where a player actually reads it.

THE PLAYER-FACING COPY, pinned rather than waved through with a bare toast wait: canon bracket voice, both retiring parents named, the new class named, and NOTHING else -- no merged-level number, no counter, no stat grammar.

THE JOURNAL HALF. The merge toast carries lore:true, so the same sentence is banked to the durable Lore record -- a class the player never chose to lose can be read back at leisure instead of living or dying by one toast's render race.
To the goblin camp: teleport to the lane above goblin_encounter_1 (30,23) and step into its radius-2 trigger, the same beat druid_consolidation_loop fights.

THE KIT PROOF, all three halves. sworn_fang_ride_together is [Beast Master]'s OWN L14 grant reaching the merged class through `inherits` -- the Skill the pre-#438 merge into [Druid] would have deleted, and the entire reason this class was authored. counsel_of_the_wild is [Wild Sage]'s OWN L14 grant, the re-flavored twin of [Druid]'s [Peace of the Wild]. flash_step is the mage half of the same fold, so this also proves BOTH parent lines survive the merge rather than the beast one winning.
